summary: Verified fix for 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' TypeError. Logged in as admin, navigated through: /console (dashboard with period dropdown opened, options Aujourd'hui/7j/30j/90j selected), /console/statistiques (initial load + Ventes tab + remaining 11 tab texts attempted), /console/livraisons, /console/marques, /console/fournisseurs, /console/liste-attente, /console/stats (legacy), /console/manuel, /console/finances, /console/settings. ZERO 'cannot read properties of undefined' errors across all pages. Positive assertion passed: Statistiques → Ventes shows real KPIs (CA Commandé 9 925 500 FCFA, CA Livré 5 341 000 FCFA, Panier moyen 91 059 FCFA) and heatmap jour×heure, confirming guards do not hide real data.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows '+NaN%' and '· NaN' for the comparison delta when previous-period value is 0 (division by zero). Not a crash, but cosmetic.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' at ConsoleLayout line 140/183. Fire-and-forget warning, no visual impact but should be fixed by removing <span> inside <option> elements.

testid_discrepancies.issue: Task description mentions data-testid=stat-tab-{ventes,produits,…} and period-today/period-7d/period-30d/period-90d. Neither exist in rendered DOM. Only data-testid=period-selector (one dropdown button) exists on Dashboard and Statistiques; stat tabs are rendered as plain tab buttons with text labels and no testid. Suggest adding testids for stable E2E coverage.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to Statistiques tab triggers (stat-tab-ventes … stat-tab-zones) and dashboard period options (period-today/7d/30d/90d/custom) so automated tests can target them.
Fix NaN% display on Dashboard TAUX D'ANNULATION when prev-period cancellation count is 0 (guard the pct delta calc).
Fix hydration warning: remove <span> inside <option> in ConsoleLayout (lines ~140 and ~183).
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive `|| []` guards are the right short-term fix but the proper fix is Pydantic models or TS types that guarantee shape at the API layer; otherwise future endpoints will silently reintroduce the bug.
Multiple pages still trust raw backend DTOs (`d.FIELD.map` style) — recommend a thin adapter in each page's useEffect that normalises the payload once, instead of guarding every call site.
ConsoleLayout emits React hydration warnings (<span> inside <option>) — SSR/CSR mismatch risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Task-listed testids (stat-tab-*, period-today/7d/30d/90d) do NOT exist in DOM — only period-selector dropdown and plain tab buttons. For future tab navigation use get_by_role('tab', name=…) or add testids. Dashboard period is a dropdown with options Aujourd'hui/Hier/Cette semaine/7 derniers jours/30 derniers jours/90 derniers jours/… — not individual buttons. Login testids: login-email, login-password. Guided tour auto-opens on fresh login; close with [data-testid=tour-close] or set localStorage keys starting with 'dina_tour_' = '1'. Dashboard has NaN%/NaN cosmetic bug on TAUX D'ANNULATION card when previous-period cancellations = 0.
rca of the issue: Original crash root cause: backend endpoints occasionally return partial payloads (missing arrays/objects). Frontend code called `.map`, `.slice`, `.length`, `.filter` directly on these optional fields. E1's bulk patch to insert `(obj.field || [])` default-empty guards resolves every reported crash site. Reproduction before fix: navigate to Statistiques tabs where backend omits one aggregate field. After fix: no TypeError observed across all 10 surfaces tested. Preferred long-term mitigation: normalise API shape via Pydantic defaults server-side (e.g. `channels: list = []`) and/or type the response in TypeScript.
